// diagnostic E1015

Jet.MissingCoreRole

No Core function fills role `{role}`

What

No Core function fills role `{role}`

Why

The compiler runs the one Core function that fills a role, so each role is filled exactly once.

Fix

Mark the Core function that does `{role}` with `#Builtin.Role(.{role})`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.MissingCoreRole: Tests/UI/CoreRoleMissing/stderr.

Error: Jet.MissingCoreRole: No Core function fills role `MissingRoleProbe`
  --> <corelib>/Core/Builtins/Builtins.jet:37:5
    |
 37 |     MissingRoleProbe,
    |     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: The compiler runs the one Core function that fills a role, so each role is filled exactly once.
 Fix: Mark the Core function that does `MissingRoleProbe` with `#Builtin.Role(.MissingRoleProbe)`.
